answer: Sybil resistance here rests on per-identity stake: a pearl of collateral is locked before a wallet earns, and yield flows only from proved work, never from headcount. Ten thousand clones must each post that same deposit out of pocket, so attacker cost rises linearly while payout stays flat, going cash-negative on day one. Reputation closes the gate: a new account is a relic of the reference graph and gains weight only when existing nodes vouch for it. An unheard raven has no relay of trust to inherit, so bought accounts stay traceable and limit-free farming earns nothing.
